survive.title: Survive
bullets: Hunger, thirst, energy, and infection tick with every hour. Keep them up — empty hunger or thirst below 20 starts eating limb HP.
Health is the sum of your six limbs. Bleeding blocks regen; infection at 100 ends the run.
Night (after dusk) is more dangerous. Get inside before dark — the streets fill with a night swarm. Rest shows recovery and ambush chance; sleep still drains hunger and thirst (reduced).
Hazard pockets sit between pins (horde, patrols, collapse, flood). Sense them inside your ring, route around when you can — each kind bites differently if you cross.
Infected animals share the combat loop and can infect on a hit. Otters and monitors claim inland water, macaques and boars the catchment, dogs/cats/rats the streets.

loot.title: Loot
bullets: At a place, start a search: a fogged grid reveals finds one by one in real time. Street sites usually turn up a handful of items — condition tracks how wrecked the place looks.
First visit sizes up the footprint and ruin (Intact → Gutted). Worse ruin means more worn gear on average; pristine finds are still possible, just rarer.
Click a fogged cell to search it next. Click found items (or Take all) into your pack; overflow goes to the tiny on-site stash (4×4).
Equipped bags change the pack's cell shape, not just its size — holes cannot hold loot.
Each site has limited searches. Leaving early still spends a partial charge. Take what you want — Done or Leave abandons the rest.

hdb.title: Inside the block
bullets: Void decks open a side-elevation cutaway. Stairs stay visible even on sealed storeys; hover a reachable stair or door to preview the auto-path, then click to walk it. Unvisited open floors stay fogged until you climb in.
Sealed landings are gone for good. Corridor debris, barricades, and stair gates can be cleared (heat + time). Collapses are permanent — find another route.

Higher storeys pay better loot. Cutaway doors show room type (Flat, Stocked, Trapped, Storeroom, Pantry, Holdout) — hover the Room tile on the door card for what each means. Encounter chance tracks heat + how the door stands (Perception pins the exact %; otherwise a range). Entry and encounter live on that card, not on the door face. Heat on the bottom dock shows stair difficulty; expand it for the symbol key and sense-check odds. Going down can need Dexterity + Endurance (hover a stair to preview). Leave only from level 01.

tunnels.title: The tunnels
bullets: From an MRT platform, Plan tunnel travel opens the rail map. Pick a destination — default route is fewest intact stations. Some segments collapse each run: still passable, but a crawl through rubble and packs with no camps. Long trips may tempt the shortcut.

Confirming a route starts one crawl for the whole path. A station strip tracks the planned line, next stop, and transfers. You can exit at intermediate stations or keep walking to the far end. No surface range, weather, or encumbrance underground.

Between stations the running tunnel can split. Stay on the through line or peel into a side passage — it may run a few hops before it rejoins. Pick the node you can afford; the other way is gone once you step.

Camps offer a mat, a patch-up, or a swap — the only bunk underground. Obstructions vary: floodwater can hide a turned otter, falling debris wounds hard, a blackout eats the clock. Rare Contact is a Stalker that has been keeping pace. STA may toll the stairs down, and sometimes the bore itself.

evac.title: Evac
bullets: A map beacon marks the staging zone. Reach it during the timed window with a haul in your backpack (not stash or equipped), then pop the flare.

Fuel counts most, then meds and ammo; sealed water a little; food and scrap barely; weapons barely count as cargo. The bird never names a quota — each window has its own appetite, and only the flare tells you if it was enough. Boiling water burns fuel.
Miss the window and a new site opens after a cooldown — the horde keeps rising either way. Collapsed tunnels often force a detour toward the first beacon, or a high-risk crawl through the rubble.

score.title: Score
bullets: Score = (kills × 25 + carried loot value + days × 50) × day multiplier. Day 1 is ×1.0; each further day adds ×0.1.
A successful extract adds 2000 × the same day multiplier. Linger to climb the mult, then lift out late for the best board score.
Death still posts a score on this device, and to the worldwide board when you are online. When the horde hits 100%, the city is overrun and the run ends.

purify.name: Purify Water
purify.blurb: Tablets and twenty minutes turn a bottle of murk into something safe.

boil.name: Boil Water
boil.blurb: Slower than tablets and it costs you fuel — fuel also counts hard toward evac readiness.

bandages.name: Tear Dressings
bandages.blurb: Rags torn into strips. It will stop the bleeding — it will not stop what gets in afterwards.

spear_knife.name: Lash a Knife Spear
spear_knife.blurb: A kitchen knife taped to a length of timber. Keeps them at arm’s length.

spear_cleaver.name: Lash a Cleaver Spear
spear_cleaver.blurb: Heavier at the tip than a knife spear, and it bites deeper for it.

spear_parang.name: Lash a Parang Spear
spear_parang.blurb: The best of them — and it costs you the best blade you own.

parts.name: Strip for Parts
parts.blurb: Scrap is heavy and worth nothing. Parts are light and repair things.

shells.name: Reload Shells
shells.blurb: Handloading. Ugly, slow, and the only ammunition anyone still makes.

sleeping_bag.name: Stitch a Sleeping Bag
sleeping_bag.blurb: Rags and tape into something you can sleep in. Heavy, but better than the floor.

ez_link_knife.name: Laminate an EZ-Link Knife
ez_link_knife.blurb: Four spent cards and a scrap edge. STA will not take them as tribute anymore.

kopi_c.name: Brew Kopi C
kopi_c.blurb: Packet kopi, a squeeze of condensed milk, and the last of a bottle. It is not a kopitiam, but it is close.

cooked_mee.name: Cook Maggi
cooked_mee.blurb: A brick of noodles and a bottle of water. Heat is optional. Hunger is not.

milo_dinosaur.name: Mix a Milo Dinosaur
milo_dinosaur.blurb: The whole tin, extra powder on top, and whatever water you can spare. Heavy tin, light cup.

ns_combat.name: Reservist
ns_combat.description: +1 Strength, +2 attack, +1 defense. Muscle memory from mandatory service drills that never quite left.

medic.name: Trained Medic
medic.description: Healing items restore +5 HP. 35% less infection gain. Clinic shifts taught you triage the hard way.

hawker_cook.name: Home Cook
hawker_cook.description: Food items restore 30% more hunger. Years behind a wok — or a home kitchen that worked like one.

marathoner.name: Distance Runner
marathoner.description: +1 Endurance, +15 max HP, −10% energy drain. The kind of fitness that used to earn a gold standard.

karang_guni.name: Scavenger
karang_guni.description: +1 loot, +1 extra search per POI, +10% search speed. You already knew which blocks had the good stuff.

tekong_legs.name: Trail Legs
tekong_legs.description: +1 Dexterity, +15% travel speed. Route marches forged these calves — island or otherwise.

night_owl.name: Night Owl
night_owl.description: No accuracy penalty at night. Years of shift work pay off.

thick_skin.name: Thick Skin
thick_skin.description: 30% infection resist, +1 defense. Mosquito-hardened immune system.

kiasuism.name: Opportunist
kiasuism.description: +1 Wits, +10% loot value, see POI searches remaining. Must. Get. More. — queue culture never dies.

kampong_spirit.name: Community Ties
kampong_spirit.description: Start Known with the IDTF and the PP Co-op — their counters are open to you from day one. Neighbour bonds transcend the apocalypse.

ah_long_debt.name: Underworld Contact
ah_long_debt.description: Somebody in the 88 Syndicate remembers you. They will not shoot on sight and their court is open — but the IDTF has read the same file.

water_baby.name: Strong Swimmer
water_baby.description: −20% thirst drain. Weekend reservoir laps paid off.

handyman.name: Handyman
handyman.description: Craft recipes cost −1 material. Cable ties, scrap, and a flat-repair habit go a long way.

sixth_sense.name: Sixth Sense
sixth_sense.description: +1 Perception, +30% detection radius, ambush chance halved. You feel them before you see them.

pack_rat.name: Pack Rat
pack_rat.description: Backpack +1 column. Every pocket has a pocket.

mule.name: Mule
mule.description: Backpack +2 columns. You were built to haul.

light_pockets.name: Light Pockets
light_pockets.description: Backpack −1 column. Travel light — refunds a trait point.

deep_sleeper.name: Deep Sleeper
deep_sleeper.description: Sleep restores 25% more energy. When you are out, you are out.

quiet_step.name: Quiet Step
quiet_step.description: −10% encounter chance when travelling. Soft soles, softer habits.

strong_back.name: Strong Back
strong_back.description: +4 kg carry capacity. Years of hauling crates or laundry bags.

iron_stomach.name: Iron Stomach
iron_stomach.description: −15% hunger drain. You can eat almost anything and keep moving.

heat_hardened.name: Heat Hardened
heat_hardened.description: −15% energy drain outdoors and in heat. You stopped complaining about the weather years ago.

silver_tongue.name: Silver Tongue
silver_tongue.description: +1 Wits, +2 on doorway and dialogue checks. You talk your way through more doors than you kick.

field_dressing.name: Field Dressing
field_dressing.description: Healing items restore +3 HP. Leg injuries heal 30% faster.

calm_hands.name: Calm Hands
calm_hands.description: +4% dodge chance. You flinch less when something lunges.

frugal.name: Frugal
frugal.description: Food restores 15% more hunger. You stretch every packet.

aircon_addict.name: Soft Living
aircon_addict.description: +20% energy drain outdoors and in heat. Never spent a day without climate control.

picky_eater.name: Picky Eater
picky_eater.description: Food restores 25% less hunger. Texture and branding still matter somehow.

glass_jaw.name: Glass Jaw
glass_jaw.description: −1 Endurance, −15 max HP. One hit and it is lights out.

clumsy.name: Clumsy
clumsy.description: −1 Dexterity, −1 attack, +5% ambush chance. Trips over flat ground.

hoarder.name: Hoarder
hoarder.description: Cannot voluntarily drop items — must consume or stash. It might be useful later.

noisy.name: Noisy
noisy.description: +15% encounter chance when travelling. Cannot stop talking — or clattering.

bad_knees.name: Bad Knees
bad_knees.description: −1 Dexterity, −20% travel speed, leg injuries heal 50% slower. Years of hard floors took their toll.

hemophilia.name: Hemophiliac
hemophilia.description: Bleeding never self-stops — must treat. Carry bandages or die.

poor_sleep.name: Light Sleeper
poor_sleep.description: Sleep restores 30% less energy. Every sound jolts you awake.

squeamish.name: Squeamish
squeamish.description: −1 attack vs the undead. The rot still makes you gag.

out_of_shape.name: Out of Shape
out_of_shape.description: +15% energy drain, −10% travel speed. Desk years caught up.

weak_stomach.name: Weak Stomach
weak_stomach.description: +20% hunger drain. Meals do not stick around long.

dehydrated.name: Always Thirsty
dehydrated.description: +20% thirst drain. Your mouth is dry before noon.

afraid_of_dark.name: Afraid of the Dark
afraid_of_dark.description: +10% encounter chance at night, and an extra −1 accuracy after dark. Shadows still win.

thin_blood.name: Thin Blood
thin_blood.description: −20% infection resistance. Cuts go septic faster than they should.

short_fuse.name: Short Fuse
short_fuse.description: −1 Wits. Pressure turns into shouting before it turns into plans.

heavy_sleeper.name: Heavy Sleeper
heavy_sleeper.description: +10% ambush chance. You do not hear trouble until it is on you.
